title: 日本ダービーの後に・磨穿鉄硯

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And so my dreams are dashed.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But my resolve remains, awaiting the day that I realize my ideals.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If strength is the mark of a ruler, then I still have one chance left to prove mine.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Precisely. It is said that the Kikuka Sho goes to the strongest Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Let us show the world that the Emperor does not yield.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the end, we decide to aim for the Kikuka Sho as planned.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Fine work today, President.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The result may not have been what you hoped, but you raced with dignity.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I may have failed to meet your expectations today, but I swear that next time, I will return victorious.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You mean…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Naturally, I intend to aim for the Kikuka Sho. My march of conquest is not yet done.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I have no doubt that you will acquit yourself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But surely you realize that this will strain your schedule to the limit?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Summer may be coming, but you will have more press interviews than ever. And naturally, the student council will be—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No, I'm listening. Please, continue.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: With respect, you do look rather tired.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha. Forgive me. Even I can't maintain perfect form after a race like that.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Perhaps you should refrain from student council work for a little—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I believe we have already discussed that point. Let's move on to something more constructive.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: To pick up on your earlier point, the student council has important work to do come the summer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Come now, Trainer. Surely you haven't forgotten.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Every year, the academy holds a summer camp to help the students improve their racing skills. The student council helps to organize it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh, that reminds me. Air Groove, can you contact the bus company?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: We need to change the number of buses we'll be hiring, and there are also some other issues I want to discuss.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That being said, the press is outside, and I can hardly keep them waiting. Let's see now…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'll be back at the academy in two hours. Could you set up the meeting for when I return?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Of course.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even after the grueling ordeal that was the Japanese Derby, Symboli Rudolf shows no signs of relaxing her unforgiving schedule.
